prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving home from work on a weekday afternoon, moving slowly through a busy intersection in Katy, when the car in front of me stopped suddenly. I braked as hard as I could, but the vehicle coming toward me crossed into my lane and our front bumpers met head-on. The impact was low speed, but my head snapped forward and struck the steering wheel. I felt dizzy, had a ringing in my ears, and a headache that got worse over the next hour. The other driver and I both pulled over safely. Paramedics checked me at the scene and advised me to go to the hospital, where I was diagnosed with a concussion. My doctor has placed me on rest and limited screen time, and I have had to stop driving for a short period. I am submitting this statement to document what happened and the injuries I sustained.
